after: turning-points.md and ladder.md: the side has been a coin flip at every turn and every level; expansion.md: volatility expansion is forecastable (AUC 0.78); models.md: a small logistic regression beats trees and MLPs on this desk's features
question: can a break of structure (BOS: a close beyond the live swing high or swing low) be predicted before it happens - when (a) and which way (b) - beyond what the geometry of the two levels already says, and beyond iid and GARCH walks

levels.swings: MCFL v2 EXTREMEs (3/3 pivots: 3 bars either side, known 3 bars after the swing, at known_at)
levels.H: at bar t: the most recent (by swing bar) swing high known by t with no close above its price on any bar after the swing up to t (unbroken); so H >= close[t]
levels.L: the mirror: the most recent known swing low with no close below it since the swing
levels.frozen: H and L are fixed at t for the labels; later swings do not move them

sample.bars: every bar t from bar 300 (warm-up) where H and L both exist and t + 60 is inside the series; 4h every bar, 1h every 3rd bar (t % 3 == 0)
sample.flip: none: the chart is not flipped, labels stay up/down as they are, features are written with H-side and L-side columns (and antisymmetric ones such as the 5-bar move) so the linear model can be symmetric but is not forced to be

targets.a_timing: a close beyond H or beyond L within N bars after t (bars t+1..t+N); N = 24 on 1h, 12 on 4h (two days of 4h, one day of 1h)
targets.b_side: among bars whose first close beyond H or L comes within 60 bars, 1 if that first close is above H, 0 if below L

features.note: all known at t's close; ATR is Wilder's (ewm alpha 1/n) of true range; every price distance is in ATR(14) at t unless said; non-finite values become 0 (relative volume 1), all clipped to [-50, 50]
G1 volatility: (max high - min low of the last 10 bars)/ATR50
Bollinger width (4 sd of 20 closes, in ATR50) as a percentile of its last 100 values

G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.repeated pivot flag, H and L: an earlier swing of the same side whose bar is within 100 bars before the level's swing and at least 5 bars from it, priced within 0.25 ATR14(t) of the level
G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.movement toward: (close[t] - close[t-5])/ATR14 (positive toward H, negative toward L)
G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.relative volume: volume[t] / mean volume of the 20 bars before t
G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.directional pressure: mean close location ((c-l)-(h-c))/(h-l) over the last 5 bars; and the same weighted by each bar's relative volume
G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.absorption, H and L: mean over the last 5 bars of relvol x max(0, 1 - range/ATR14(t)) on bars whose high is within 0.5 ATR of H (for H), whose low is within 0.5 ATR of L (for L)
G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.compression: (max high - min low of the last 5 bars)/ATR14
G2 levels likely to break (Zeiierman, re.fresh touches, H and L: number of the last 20 bars whose high reached H - 0.25 ATR (for H), whose low reached L + 0.25 ATR (for L)

G3 Weinstein stage (MarkitTick, re-imple.slope: (SMA[t] - SMA[t-4])/ATR14 (in ATR, not %, so arithmetic walks are scale-free), as a z against its own sd over the 500 bars before t
G3 Weinstein stage (MarkitTick, re-imple.flat band: rising if slope z > +0.5, falling if < -0.5, else flat (the band scales per timeframe through the slope's own sd)
G3 Weinstein stage (MarkitTick, re-imple.breakout / breakdown: close above the highest high / below the lowest low of the 30 bars before t
G3 Weinstein stage (MarkitTick, re-imple.machine: starts in 1 at bar 0. 1: breakdown -> 4, breakout -> 2. 2: breakdown -> 4; failed breakout (within 10 bars of entering 2, a close below the 30-bar high it broke) -> 1; the MA stops rising (it has been rising at some bar since entering 2 and now is not) -> 3. 3: breakdown -> 4, breakout -> 2. 4: breakout -> 2; the MA stops falling (it has been falling at some bar since entering 4 and now is not) -> 1. Checked in that order, one transition a bar

G4 FVG magnet (Neblok, re-implemented).gaps: up gap at k: low[k] > high[k-2], zone [high[k-2], low[k]]; down gap: high[k] < low[k-2], zone [high[k], low[k-2]]; size >= 0.25 ATR14(k); known at k
G4 FVG magnet (Neblok, re-implemented).filled: up gap: the first bar after k whose low <= high[k-2]; down gap: whose high >= low[k-2]; looked for 150 bars, after which the gap expires unfilled
G4 FVG magnet (Neblok, re-implemented).live at t: formed at k <= t, not filled by t, t - k < 150; above price if its middle is above close[t], else below
per side (above, below), the nearest liv: distance in ATR (0 inside the zone; 10 when none; capped 10)
G4 FVG magnet (Neblok, re-implemented).learned fill rate: keyed by (gap type up/down, size bucket <0.5, 0.5-1, 1-2, 2+ ATR, age bucket 0-9, 10-49, 50-149 bars): among gaps of the series resolved (filled, or expired at k+150) by t that survived unfilled to the age bucket's start, (1 + filled)/(2 + count); 0 when no gap on that side
G4 FVG magnet (Neblok, re-implemented).magnet pull: fill rate/(1 + distance) above minus the same below

G5 MCFL violence: DISPLACE_C, DELIVERY_SHIFT, BREACH_REVERT, each up and each down (MCFL parse, known_at), completed on any of the last 5 bars: 6 flags
range_z of bar t: (range - mean)/sd of the 10 ranges before it, clipped +-10
features.G6 structure sentence: the last three MCFL v2 swing labels known at t (HH LH EH LL HL EL), one-hot per position: 18 flags

model: logistic regression, features standardised on the training rows, L2 with C = 1.0, lbfgs; one model per venue and per source, 1h and 4h pooled (is_4h in G0)
walk_forward: train on bars whose label window ends before 2024-01-01 (ts + 61 bars < split, a purge), score bars at or after 2024-01-01. MT5's US SP 500, US Tech 100, Germany 40 and US Oil begin 2024-01-22: test rows only
score: held-out AUC of each set; 'beyond geometry' = AUC(G0+X) - AUC(G0) on the same rows, with a day-bootstrap 90% interval (resample test days with replacement, 1000 draws, the same draws for every set)

nulls.iid: mcfl.synth.walk with the series' close-to-close sd, 256 sub-steps a bar, the real timestamps
nulls.garch: mcfl.synth.garch (alpha 0.08, beta 0.90) with the same sigma, 256 sub-steps, real timestamps
nulls.volume: walks get synthetic volume from mcfl.synth.ticks so the volume features exist
nulls.pipeline: identical: same features, labels, split and model, fitted on each walk family per venue

predicts_if: a group's real held-out gain over G0 has its 90% interval above 0 AND its point gain is larger than its gain on the iid walks AND larger than on the GARCH walks (same venue, same target)
primary: (b) side, G0+all vs G0, Binance (12 perpetuals, 1h and 4h pooled)
secondary: held-out AUC per timeframe and per test half (2024; 2025 on), reported not gated
also: calibration of the side model (G0+all and G0, Binance real, held out) in deciles of predicted P(up first); a gallery of held-out Binance 4h examples
follow_up_only_if_b_passes: in the top decile of P(up first), long at t+1's open with the stop beyond L (and the mirror short in the bottom decile), exits frozen separately before any trade runs. Not run unless the primary passes
data: Binance perpetuals (BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP DOGE ADA AVAX LINK LTC DOT TRX), 2021 on; MT5 (EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY XAUUSD US SP 500 US Tech 100 Germany 40 US Oil BTCUSD ETHUSD); 1h and 4h
